_doc: Classification rules for normalize-sundial.mjs / compare-sundial.mjs. Every (section,label) value extracted from a Sundial capture is bucketed into one of: DROP (volatile, never compared), PROXY_DERIVED (follows geoip:true from the proxy exit IP — compared by shape/consistency, not exact value), or SPOOFED_STABLE (the default: must match exactly between old and new builds run with the same `os` spoof). A value is also DROPped if it matches any volatileValuePattern, regardless of label. Matching is case-insensitive substring for label rules, and regex for value patterns. See normalize-sundial.mjs for how these are applied.
_dropLabelNotes: Deliberately NOT dropping by label: verdict rows whose value is just pass/ok/fail ('WebRTC private IP leak', 'SDP private IP leak', 'WebRTC leak verdict') — these are STABLE signals, and their values carry no IP so the volatileValuePatterns leave them alone. 'connection.type' is a stable capability signal (kept). Broad words like 'date'/'time'/'raf' were narrowed ('local time', 'refresh rate') so we don't nuke 'DateTimeFormat'/'time zone' stable rows. The second block (history.length / performance.* / ResOverflow / live AnalyserNode reads / DynamicsCompressor.reduction) is empirically run-to-run volatile EVEN with a pinned fingerprint + zeroed audio seed: they measure live float/timing/stack state, not fingerprint identity. The STABLE audio identity hashes ('Fingerprint audio hash', 'Audio fingerprint (osc+comp hash)', 'OscillatorNode/AnalyserNode/DynamicsCompressorNode N property fields hash') are NOT in this list and remain compared — only the realtime AnalyserNode *data* reads jitter. Confirmed by a pinned same-build two-run dropping 43→0 divergences.

_notes.spoofed_stable_examples: fonts list + count, canvas/DOMRect hash, WebGL vendor/unmasked renderer, audio hash/sampleRate, navigator.platform/oscpu, screen.width/height/avail, colorDepth, hardwareConcurrency, CSS.supports probe bitmask, WebRTCHash composite (after stripping the mDNS/IP rows above). These are NOT listed individually — anything not matched by a DROP or PROXY_DERIVED rule defaults to SPOOFED_STABLE and must match exactly.
_notes.why_webrtc_rows_drop: The Network section mixes stable WebRTC capability signals (codec matrices, SDP counts, leak verdict 'pass') with per-session volatile values (mDNS UUID hostnames like <uuid>.local, the gathered IP list, ICE foundation/candidate counts). The volatileValuePatterns strip the UUID/IP-bearing rows so the stable capability signals still compare; 'foundation'/'ice candidate'/'ip list' label drops cover the rest.
_notes.why_refresh_rate_drops: Display refresh rate (rAF) is measured as 'N Hz' and varies with Xvfb scheduling load between runs — not a browser-identity signal.
_notes.proxy_derived_shape_check: compare-sundial.mjs does NOT fail when a PROXY_DERIVED value changes; it only checks the value is still well-formed (e.g. timezone is a valid-looking IANA zone, language is a BCP-47 tag). A malformed/empty proxy-derived value where the baseline had a good one IS flagged, because that indicates the geoip path broke.
